text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000574 bills 99215 well above expectation within every complexity tier, but the two charts returned support their billed level, so documentation is too thin to separate upcoding from a complex panel.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The by-complexity table shows this provider's 99215 share running roughly double the all-provider share in the one-, two- and three-condition tiers, so the excess is not explained by a sicker panel. Sampled low-complexity 99215s such as C0270743 and C0271395 (single condition) and C0271172 (no chronic conditions, rash only) fit a pattern consistent with upcoding. Against that, both documented 99215 claims were supported, though one of them, C0270822, is a hypothyroidism-only visit recorded as high MDM with no time noted, which a reviewer should check for cloned or inflated note content. With records for only about 1% of claims and just two documented 99215s, the documentation cannot confirm or refute the statistical signal. A reviewer should first request charts for the low-complexity 99215 sample, starting with the zero-condition claims C0270964, C0271172, C0271204 and C0271946, and compare their MDM and time against the billed level."}
